notes.title: Notice of Ver. 1.0.0 Release
notes.notes:
"GAIA Survivors" Ver. 1.0.0 is released!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333543/64c7b46ead8d6475156e678b9b379b330924d5ae.gif[/img]

"New features"
[list]
[*] Two player characters have been added, bringing the total number of aircraft to eight!
[*] The fourth stage is in outer space, and a large number of too-strong enemies appear!
[*] Five new weapons, including the "Quark Slicer" and the "Antimatter Mine," and their evolved weapons, for a total of 10 new weapons have been added!
[/list]

"Fixes"
[list]
[*] Result is now displayed even when the ingame was terminated in the middle of a game.
[*] Fixed a bug in the UI.
[*] Fixed some in-game text.
[*] Improved translation in some languages.
[/list]

Please enjoy!
We are looking forward to your feedback in the community!

notes.title: Ver. 0.7.0 released.
notes.notes:
Ver. 0.7.0 has been released.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333543/9346763b9cfdeb99b47956bb9c568a16207d3eff.png[/img]

[b]Content to be added[/b]
[list]
[*] Stage 3 added. Out of the atmosphere and into space!　New enemies and bosses will attack you.
[*] Added player character, "THE TOMB".
[*] Added 3 new weapons such as the "Homing Missile" and its 3 evolved weapons.
[/list]

[b]Fixes, etc.[/b]
[list]
[*] Some in-game text has been corrected and textures have been replaced.
[*] Fixed a case where defeating an enemy with a super damaging item did not affect the unlock opening conditions.
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Pre-release Announcement - No.1
notes.notes:
"The Earth of Despair, overrun by the clutches of outer space, and a dying humanity. But now is the time for the brave survivors of the resistance to awaken and strike back with their giant robots.
Players are charged with the mission to boldly confront a raging enemy with unlimited ingenuity and a wealth of armaments in hand!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44333543/89d5bbafe1b7960680b070b1008c0fddb3ac580a.gif[/img]
